name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Algae goes with Eklund or 16 ly goes with Algae.
Bauer does not go with 18 ly if and only if 20 ly goes with Algae.
Between Bauer and Okafor, one goes with Algae and the other with Regolith.

hints.text: Suppose Bauer went with Basalt — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Bauer goes with Basalt.
Bauer goes with Basalt, so it can't also go with Algae.
Bauer goes with Basalt, so it can't also go with Regolith.
…but now the clue “Between Bauer and Okafor, one goes with Algae and the other with Regolith” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Bauer does not go with Basalt.

hints.text: Suppose Eklund didn't go with Basalt — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
